name: Single-phase autotransformer
summary: A single-phase autotransformer uses a winding portion shared electrically by its input and output circuits.
description: A single-phase autotransformer uses a winding portion shared electrically by its input and output circuits. Its drawing must make the common connection clear because it does not provide winding separation like a two-winding transformer.
readingNotes: Trace the common winding terminal and identify the supply and load tap positions.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An autotransformer is not an isolating two-winding transformer.
